timeScale.description: Speed: Game minutes per real minute: 2 makes a game day last 12 real hours, 30 is GTA Online's 48 minutes.

freezeTime.description: Stop the clock: Time stands still at the current hour.

startHour.description: Hour after a restart: The clock starts at this hour when the server starts.

dynamic.description: Changing weather: Off: the first weather of the list stays.

weathers.description: Weathers: GTA weather names in the order they follow (EXTRASUNNY, CLEAR, CLOUDS, OVERCAST, RAIN, THUNDER, CLEARING, FOGGY, SMOG, SNOW, XMAS...).

changeMinutes.description: Change every: Real minutes between weather changes.

blackout.description: Blackout: City lights go out (vehicles keep their lights).
